message: The other day, I found myself feeling a bit smug when my neighbor asked for help packing their go-bag. I had just gone through mine the week before, making sure everything was up to date. It felt good to share my little bit of knowledge and remind myself how important it is to be ready, even if it’s just a small step. 😊 Have you had a moment like that where your prep paid off? What’s your favorite tip for staying ready?
